```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>"
)
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
pkgload::load_all(".")
library(dplyr)
library(glue)
library(htmltools)

```

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
cancer <- c("bladder", "breast", "colorectal",
            "lung", "melanoma", "oesophagus",
            "prostate")
edition <- "7th"

for (i in seq_along(cancer)) {

  section_title <- glue(
    "{cancer[i]} {edition} edition"
  )

  cat(sprintf(
    "<details>
       <summary>%s</summary>",
    htmlEscape(section_title)
  ))

  table <- stagesRules(
    edition = edition,
    cancer = cancer[i],
    type = "base"
  ) |>
    select(-rule_id) |>
    arrange(uicc_stage) |>
    visOmopResults::visTable(
      groupColumn = "uicc_stage"
    )

  print(table)

  cat("</details>\n")
}
```
